channel.title: Rolling Stone L.L.C. - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Rolling Stone L.L.C. (rollingstone.com)

item.title: Tom Morello Will Protest Fascism With ‘Solidarity & Resistance’ Benefit Concert in Minnesota
item.description: Tom Morello, Rise Against, Al Di Meola, Ike Reilly, and more guests will perform on Jan. 30 with proceeds benefiting the families of Renee Good and Alex Pretti, who were killed by ICE agents

item.title: Neil Young Wages War Against Apple, Verizon Over Trump Support
item.description: "I am trying to not support the companies that support the regime with huge donations, just to cover their own asses, while people are being shot in the streets of America," Young writes

item.title: ‘Real Housewives of New York City’ Star Dorinda Medley Dishes On DJ’ing, Dry January, & ‘Traitors’
item.description: We sat down with Dorinda Medley to talk about her time on Peacock’s hit series, what’s on her current playlist, and her partnership with spirit-free brand Seedlip

item.title: Here’s How You Can Still Buy Tickets to Hilary Duff’s Sold-Out Small Rooms, Big Nerves Tour Online
item.description: The singer recently broke the internet by performing “What Dreams Are Made Of” live for the first time. Here’s how to make sure you don’t miss it again

item.title: Ray J Says He’s in His ‘Last Days’ Due to Deteriorating Heart Health: ‘I F-cked Up’
item.description: In a video, the singer detailed the impact years of substance abuse had on his heart health, nodded to the ongoing legal battle with his wife, and said his sister Brandy is covering his bills

item.title: Steven Tyler Accuser Can Proceed With California Sex Abuse Claims Only, Judge Says
item.description: The Aerosmith musician asked the court to dismiss the entire lawsuit, saying he lived with Julia Misley in Boston during their relationship, where the age of consent was 16

item.title: Grammy Nominee Laura Veltz on Writing Songs in Nashville: ‘Hate Not Welcome’
item.description: Up for Songwriter of the Year at this Sunday's Grammy Awards, Veltz has written hits with Jessie Murph, Demi Lovato, Dan + Shay, and more

item.title: Nicki Minaj Bravely Vows to Protect World’s Biggest Bully
item.description: After appearing with the president in Washington, the rapper posted a photo of her “Trump Gold Card" — which promises "U.S. residency in record time"

item.title: Chaka Khan Delivers Potent Message at Resonator Awards: ‘To the Next Generation, Your Voices Matter’
item.description: Honorees Khan, Chappell Roan, St. Vincent, and Haim took the stage with presenters Nancy Wilson, Joni Mitchell, and Olivia Rodrigo at this year's joyful ceremony

item.title: Bob Ross Paintings Fetch $1.2 Million for Public TV After Trump Axes Federal Funding
item.description: The proceeds will help buoy public television stations across the country amid the devastating cuts by the Trump administration
